subject: Re: Renewal paperwork — coverage rebalancing & MSA alignment
messages:
From: Jordan Winters <j.winter@falken.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procure@falken.ai>
Date: Sat, 30 Mar 2024 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal proposal: MSA + Order Form (term + capacity changes)

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the partnership this year — Falken AI is ready to move forward on renewal and expand our committed capacity. High level items: 24 month term (from 12), capacity uplift from 200k to 500k token units/month (phased if needed), and an updated billing cadence (monthly invoices instead of net-30).

Could you share Redwood's redlines for the MSA and a clean order form we can route to procurement? We’d like to see SLA credit language aligned to our internal risk team (specifically a 25% max credit on recurring charges) and a short-data-retention addendum for model inputs.

Attached: Falken_Renewal_Proposal.pdf, OrderForm_v3.docx (current).

Requested timing: procurement would like final countersigned docs within 7 business days so they can issue a PO and process the invoice before the end of the quarter. Is that feasible?

Best,
Jordan Winters
VP Finance, Falken AI

---
Attachment: Falken_Renewal_Proposal.pdf (summary)
Attachment: OrderForm_v3.docx (current order form)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Winters <j.winter@falken.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 31 Mar 2024 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal: MSA + Order Form (term + capacity changes)

Jordan —

Thanks for the clear ask and the proposal doc. We can support a 24-month term and the proposed capacity uplift; there are two coordination items we want to confirm before we route final docs to legal:

- Capacity schedule: do you want the full 500k tokens effective on renewal or a phased approach (250k month 1, 375k month 2, 500k month 3)?
- Billing cadence: shifting to monthly invoicing is fine but we’ll need a PO number to align with our billing team.

I’ve attached an initial Redwood redline to the MSA that addresses the data-retention addendum and a proposed cap on SLA credits (we've suggested a running 25% cap per billing period but legal may propose specific language). Please review and share any must-have redlines from your side.

Timeline: I’ll pull legal in first thing Monday (Lauren) — we expect a redline roundtrip within 48 hours and can push a countersign DocuSign within 5 business days if there are no material disputes.

Next steps: If procurement can confirm the PO timeline and your preferred capacity schedule by EOD Monday, we’ll prioritize the order form and invoice.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: Redwood_Redlines_MSA.docx (redline draft)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Apr 2024 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal — internal legal ops notes

Quick internal note (legal ops):

Soojin — flagged items for the MSA redline:
- SLA credits: we should accept 25% cap but add a per-incident ceiling (e.g., 5% per incident, cumulative cap 25%).
- Termination for convenience: limit to renewal windows only (we'll propose 90 days notice outside initial term).
- Data retention: add an optional addendum for customers using Private deployment with explicit retention window and encryption-at-rest language.
- Indemnity/limits: maintain mutual IP carveouts — don't open broad indemnities for model outputs.

I attached a short comment file for Lauren to copy into the redline. If Jordan's procurement is insistent on net-30, ops confirms we can do monthly invoices but keep net-30 payment term (billing due within 30 days of invoice).

-Rishi
Legal Ops

---
Attachment: redline_comments.txt (internal notes)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Winters <j.winter@falken.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Apr 2024 07:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal: MSA + Order Form (term + capacity changes)

Jordan — looping Lauren and Markus from Legal so you have a consolidated view. Below is a short summary of where we landed internally and an ask to confirm capacity phasing: 

Summary of proposed Redwood changes (attached merged redline):
- Term: 24 months (explicit renewal window at month 20)
- Capacity: uplift to 500k token units/month. We propose a phased schedule (250k / 375k / 500k over first three months) unless you confirm immediate ramp.
- SLA credits: Accept a 25% cumulative cap per billing period; propose 5% per incident ceiling.
- Data retention: Optional addendum for Private deployments; retention window configurable by customer up to X days (we left placeholder for number).
- Billing: Monthly invoices with net-30 payment terms.

Attached are: merged_orderform_v4.xlsx (order form with capacity schedule options) and Invoice_Proforma_Falken.pdf. I also created a DocuSign envelope for the order form and will include the MSA once we finalize a small number of open bullets. DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/documents/ABC123-falken-order

Please reply with: 1) PO timing, 2) capacity schedule (phased or immediate), 3) any artful point your legal/procurement needs us to address in the MSA text. If procurement confirms PO and signs DocuSign today we'll route to finance to get the invoice processed.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: merged_orderform_v4.xlsx (order form w/ options)
Attachment: Invoice_Proforma_Falken.pdf (proforma)

From: Jordan Winters <j.winter@falken.ai>

Soojin / team —

Appreciate the quick consolidation. Procurement has greenlit the phased schedule (250k / 375k / 500k), and we will route a PO this afternoon. We accept the SLA credit structure as described (5% per incident, 25% cumulative).

Procurement will sign the order form via DocuSign now and attach PO number in the DocuSign comments. Expect the signed envelope and PO PDF back to you within the day. Once we have the invoice and the final MSA countersigned we’ll complete the payment run next week.

Jordan Winters
VP Finance, Falken AI
